items.summary: A mod for Claude Code: a live map of the work, in a pane beside the chat. Every tool call, model step, hook and skill sends a pulse from the centre to its station, so you see memory, files, shell, web and agents at work instead of reading a list of commands. It runs on your machine and sends nothing anywhere. Local does not mean blind: like any mod that follows tool calls it is handed each call whole, and it takes names from that and nothing else. What it reads and keeps, and the checks that hold it to that.
